about.what: How each Kolej MARA Kulim building looks (roof, walls, storeys, details), for the Blender buildings of the Observatory map in both looks (tools/blender_campus.py). Appearance only: the footprints and positions come from the OpenStreetMap export (data/campus-osm.geojson) and are never changed here.
about.source: A drone video of the campus by @ikraMRahim (TikTok, https://vt.tiktok.com/ZSgSngyPK/, 56.5 s, title card "Kolej Mara Kulim"), used with the creator's permission (obtained by the owner, 2026-10-20). All 40 frames sampled by the watch tool (one every 1.4 s) were viewed.
about.method: Each building in the video was matched to its OSM footprint by its shape, size and neighbours (for example the 88 x 47 m block with the blue roof, the U-shaped block beside it, the square Surau turned about 22 degrees toward the qibla). Colours are the median of every pixel of that surface class across all 40 frames (palette below). The video is colour-graded, so colours are as filmed, not paint codes.

confidence.high: the building is clearly identified in several frames and its footprint matches
confidence.medium: a building of this kind is seen, but which of several similar footprints it is was not confirmed; the look is applied to all of them
confidence.campus-typical: the building is not clearly seen; it gets the look most campus buildings have in the video (red metal roof, white walls)

about.storeys: Counted from the video where seen, otherwise typical for the building type. Wall heights are storeys x 3.6 m + 0.6 m: estimates, not surveyed.
unplaced: a long two-storey block with a white metal roof, a red ridge stripe and a blue awning (frames 8-9, 33): not matched to a footprint
a single-storey block with a pale yellow roof and a plant-nursery frame (frames 6, 34): not matched
a grey tiled-roof house with pale blue walls (frames 35-37): not matched

tennis and futsal courts with green fencing, a blue-roofed gazebo, the car parks with white and yellow bay lines, the red-and-white kerbs and the palm rows: open ground, not buildings; the palms and the red kerbs are drawn as decoration

palette.note: Medians measured across all 40 frames by hue class (tools/blender_campus.py reads these). Colours that are not in this list (window glass, trim, the green eave of the Surau) are picked by eye from the frames named on each building.

default.seen: Red metal roofs over white walls with grey window bands are what almost every campus building has in the video (frames 1-40).

way/454535317.name: Bangunan Akademik (the large academic block)
way/454535317.seen: The largest building on campus (88 x 47 m): a low blue metal roof with a raised red skylight panel striped in white and a light-blue rooftop tank, three storeys of grey window bands, a red portal frame and a canopy over the entrance. Frames 1-4, 13, 16-17, 24, 31-32, 35-36. The positions of the skylight panel and the tank on the roof are approximate.

way/454535316.name: Bangunan Akademik (the red block south of the large block)
way/454535316.seen: A long red-roofed two-storey block directly in front of the blue-roofed block, with air-conditioning units on its roof edge and a row of palms along it. Frames 13, 16-17, 31.

way/868488564.name: Bangunan Akademik (link between the two blocks)
way/868488564.seen: The 5 m strip between the blue-roofed block and the red block reads as a red covered link in frames 16-17.

way/454535301.name: U-shaped block west of the Surau
way/454535301.seen: A U-shaped two-storey block under red hipped roofs, white walls, a red stair tower in the middle of the courtyard side. Frames 13-14, 16-18, 31. (The stair tower is not modelled.)

way/454535315.name: Surau
way/454535315.seen: A large square hall turned toward the qibla, under a pale metal roof with a tan section and a teal-green lower roof, wrapped by red covered walkways. No dome. Frames 13, 17-19, 34.

relation/11863060.name: Asrama Lelaki B
relation/11863060.seen: A courtyard dormitory under red hipped roofs, cream walls, blue awnings and open galleries round a paved court (frames 25-26). Which courtyard dormitory the video shows is not confirmed, so all three get this look. The open galleries are not modelled; the walls are cream.

gazebo.seen: The 4 x 4 m roofs on the lawns beside the Padang and the entrance road are red pyramid-roofed gazebos on white posts (frames 1-3, 21, 35-36, 38).

shelter.seen: The longer roofs are red open shelters on posts like the gazebos (frames 38, 40).

walkway.seen: Every covered walkway is a red metal roof on white posts, about 3 m wide (frames 1-7, 13, 23, 36-37).
